name: Bill Monahan

bio.statement: In his pamphlet statement, Monahan says he has lived in Tigard since 1982, served as Planning Director until 1988 and as City Manager from 1994 to 2005.
bio.excerpt: I have lived in Tigard since 1982, serving as Planning Director until 1988 and City Manager from 1994 to 2005.

positions.statement: Monahan says in his pamphlet statement that the police need a better facility but that city leaders must be more transparent and honest.

positions.statement: In a May 2026 KATU report on the $150 million bond, Monahan said the facility does not need to be combined and could be split, with police addressed first.
positions.excerpt: I don't think it needs to be a combined facility. I think it can be split and police can be sought first.
